title: The page trail (breadcrumbs) at the top of a tier's page and a matrix's page
stem: Where should the page trail start?

options.t: At Settings, as the PRD writes it: Settings › Pricing › Tiers › [tier name], and Settings › Pricing › Matrices › [matrix name]
options.why: it is the PRD's text and shows the way back to Settings

options.t: At Pricing, as the design draws it: Pricing › Tiers › [tier name]

context: The PRD writes the trail from Settings. Every design picture of these pages starts it at "Pricing ›". Everything else on these pages is tested now; only the first part of the trail waits.
where: PRD Story 2 (a tier's page) and Story 3 (a matrix's page); Tiered Pricing design canvas, pictures 2.11, 2.32, 2.46, 3.2, 4.26
